purpose: Teach: 激戦/欠損/直観/天災/幻覚/無期/呪縛/避妊

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、競合との激戦区に新店舗を出すな
lines.en: We won't open new stores in markets where competition is fierce.
lines.style: Direct, measured authority. Clear enunciation on the main clause. No warmth, no apology—a decision already made and communicated as fact. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。在庫の欠損を防ぐ管理を強化します
lines.en: Understood. I'll strengthen our inventory controls to prevent loss.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Slight lean forward. Confident but not presumptuous—showing he has already thought through next steps. Ends on a clear note of commitment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、直観と分析の両方で判断しろ
lines.en: But judge everything by both intuition and analysis.
lines.style: Corrective but not harsh. A light weight on 'both'—the emphasis is on integration, not division. Leans back slightly, letting the thought settle. Expects understanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。天災時の事業継続計画を見直します
lines.en: Understood. I'll revisit our business continuity plans for disaster scenarios.
lines.style: Measured, note-taking tone. No hesitation—he accepts the shift in direction without question. Slightly higher energy than before, showing active processing. Ends with quiet determination.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員に幻覚を見せるような誇大広告は出すな
lines.en: And don't let marketing make promises that mislead our staff.
lines.style: Sharper than before. Weight on 'don't'—a line crossed. Not angry, but the warning is felt. Slight tightness in the jaw. Back to that composed authority, but with an edge underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。無期限の契約は避けるようにします
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure we avoid open-ended contracts.
lines.style: Absorbing the warning without defensiveness. Calm, capable tone. Shows he's heard the underlying principle, not just the surface instruction. Small nod in his voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、過去の失敗の呪縛から解放されるべきだ
lines.en: We need to free ourselves from the ghosts of what went wrong before.
lines.style: Quieter, more philosophical than previous directives. Slower pace. Weight on 'free ourselves'—he's speaking to something deeper than procedure. A moment of genuine conviction underneath the authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の家族計画、避妊知識の福利も整備します
lines.en: Understood. I'll also make sure we're supporting staff with family planning and health benefits.
lines.style: Warm closing note—first time his voice softens. Not apologetic, but generous. Shows he understood the deeper message about people, not just business. Steady, assured ending.
